channel.title: Teri Eyenike
channel.description: Teri Eyenike is a software engineer in Nigeria. Explore selected projects, software work, technical writing, and contact details.

item.title: AWS Cloud Concepts for Beginners: EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, and IAM
item.description: Understand AWS cloud fundamentals and core services, including EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, and IAM, with this practical introduction for new cloud learners.

item.title: Vim for Developers: Essential Motions, Modes, and Editing Workflows
item.description: Learn practical Vim modes, navigation, text editing, and search commands, plus how to use Vim key bindings in Visual Studio Code.

item.title: Advanced Vim for Developers: Search, Motions, and Editing Commands
item.description: Practice Vim character motions, forward and backward search, text changes, line joins, case commands, formatting, and repeatable edits.

item.title: Build a Nike Sneaker Tracker with Bright Data MCP and AI Agents
item.description: Follow a project that combines Bright Data MCP, LangChain, Claude, FastAPI, and Next.js to collect and display public sneaker product details.

item.title: Build an AI Image Captioning App with Cloudinary
item.description: Build a web app that uses Cloudinary AI to generate image descriptions, helping people add useful alt text to images shared on social platforms.

item.title: Build a Content-Aware Image Cropper with Cloudinary and Streamlit
item.description: Create a Python and Streamlit app that uses Cloudinary content-aware cropping to adapt images and video to different aspect ratios.

item.title: Build a Serverless Distance Calculator with AWS Amplify and Lambda
item.description: Build a web app that calculates the distance between two coordinates with AWS Amplify, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, and DynamoDB.
